description: Recipe scaling with caller-declared non-linear rules — Scales up to 60 ingredient quantities by a servings ratio or a factor for an agent resizing a recipe or batch formula, applying per-ingredient rules the caller declares: linear (the labelled default), power exponent, fixed amounts, min/max clamps and rounding steps, with an optional display unit via unit-convert. Reports what rounding did (relative drift, rounds-to-zero). It does NOT know which in

density.description: Default density for displayUnit conversions that cross mass and volume.

unit.description: Mass per volume unit expression, e.g. g/mL, kg/m3, lb/ft3, oz/cup_us.

value.description: Caller-supplied mass per volume. Never looked up: no ingredient density table is shipped.

fromServings.description: Servings the recipe is written for.

ingredients.description: Ingredients with quantity, unit and optional scaling rule.

claimed.description: Optional claimed scaled quantity (after rounding); a mismatch fails.

density.description: Per-ingredient density for displayUnit, overriding the top-level one.

unit.description: Mass per volume unit expression, e.g. g/mL, kg/m3, lb/ft3, oz/cup_us.

value.description: Caller-supplied mass per volume. Never looked up: no ingredient density table is shipped.

displayUnit.description: Also report the scaled quantity in this unit (needs a density to cross mass and volume).

exponent.description: Exponent for rule power, caller-supplied (no culinary constants are built in).

fixedQuantity.description: Quantity for rule fixed. Defaults to the written quantity.

max.description: Upper clamp applied after the rule.

min.description: Lower clamp applied after the rule.

quantity.description: Quantity in the recipe as written.

roundTo.description: Round to a multiple of this step (0.25 cup, 1 egg).

rule.description: How the quantity scales. Default linear (quantity x factor): the labelled default, not a culinary claim. power: quantity x factor^exponent. fixed: stays at fixedQuantity (or the written quantity).

unit.description: Unit of the quantity: a unit-convert expression (g, cup_us, tbsp_metric) or any counted unit (egg, clove) that is only scaled, never converted.

maxRelativeDrift.description: Fail an ingredient when rounding moves it by more than this fraction (0.1 = 10%).

name: recipe-scale
